en: A black-and-white postcard depicting a scenic rural landscape with a prominent arched bridge crossing a river. To the left of the bridge, there is a dirt road lined with a wooden fence, and a person walking along the path. In the background are dense woods and a house. The text 'Bron vid Wiforsen' appears at the top, and the bottom border identifies the photo as being from Sundsvalls museum, with the photographer as unknown.
